row.body: The cold-room key is tied to a delivery slip marked received before the road closure. The sealed box is still listed as waiting at the storage units.
row.title: Kept from the drawer

sidecar.gloss: A delivery record marks goods received before access closed, while the box remains uncollected.
sidecar.rival_reading: A shipment of field supplies could have been delayed or misrouted; the paperwork does not identify the cargo.

row.body: Do not sell the catch until the county finishes its water check. They called it routine, but the fish order is still in the icebox and the supplier wants payment.
row.title: The unfinished handoff

sidecar.gloss: A restaurant order remains unpaid while a routine water check delays the catch.
sidecar.rival_reading: Officials could have restricted food during an emergency; the note never says what the water check was looking for.

row.body: green crop residue marks the empty sandbag; a scraped warning stripe marks the water bottle. both are tied with the same cord.
row.title: two traces on the empty sandbag

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
